run_visualize_detections: run the script to visualize object detection results from a detections pkl file onto dataset images
run_vis_with_threshold: run the vis function with a custom probability threshold to filter low-confidence detections
run_vis_first_k_images: run the vis function with a limit to visualize only the first k images in the dataset
run_vis_with_output_dir: run the vis function specifying a custom output directory for saving visualization images
run_parse_args_help: run the parse_args function to display available CLI arguments and their default values
